cohort: Participants in the Project Viva pre-birth cohort study
finding: While covariate adjustment methods impacted the association between breastfeeding and BMI z-score at 3 years, they did not impact the association between cesarean section and BMI z-score.
mod_finding: Covariate adjustment methods impacted the association between breastfeeding and BMI z-score at 3 years, with point estimates ranging widely depending on the method used.
